<B>Role:</B><BR>\\nDetektyw jest w zasad:
Roles:
The Detective is basically the investigator and prosecutor.
The Staff Assistant can perform these functions with written authority from the Detective.
The Captain/HoP/Warden is ct as the judicial authority.
The Security Officers are responsible for executing warrants, security during trial, and prisoner transport.

Investigative Phase:
After the crime has been committed the Detective's job is to gather evidence and try to ascertain not only who did it but what happened. He must take special care to catalogue everything and don't leave anything out. Write out all the evidence on paper. Make sure you take an appropriate number of fingerprints. IF he must ask someone questions he has permission to confront them. If the person refuses he can ask a judicial authority to write a subpoena for questioning. If again he fails to respond then that person is to be jailed as insubordinate and obstructing justice. Said person will be released after he cooperates.

ONCE the FT has a clear idea as to who the criminal is he is to write an arrest warrant on the piece of paper. IT MUST LIST THE CHARGES. The FT is to then go to the judicial authority and explain a small version of his case. If the case is moderately acceptable the authority should sign it. Security must then execute said warrant.

Pre-Pre-Trial Phase:
Now a legal representative must be presented to the defendant if said defendant requests one. That person and the defendant are then to be given time to meet (in the jail IS ACCEPTABLE). The defendant and his lawyer are then to be given a copy of all the evidence that will be presented at trial (rewriting it all on paper is fine). THIS IS CALLED THE DISCOVERY PACK. With a few exceptions, THIS IS THE ONLY EVIDENCE BOTH SIDES MAY USE AT TRIAL. IF the prosecution will be seeking the death penalty it MUST be stated at this time. ALSO if the defense will be seeking not guilty by mental defect it must state this at this time to allow ample time for examination.
Now at this time each side is to compile a list of witnesses. By default, the defendant is on both lists regardless of anything else. Also the defense and prosecution can compile more evidence beforehand BUT in order for it to be used the evidence MUST also be given to the other side. The defense has time to compile motions against some evidence here.
Possible Motions:
1. Invalidate Evidence- Something with the evidence is wrong and the evidence is to be thrown out. This includes irrelevance or corrupt security.
2. Free Movement- Basically the defendant is to be kept uncuffed before and during the trial.
3. Subpoena Witness- If the defense presents god reasons for needing a witness but said person fails to cooperate then a subpoena is issued.
4. Drop the Charges- Not enough evidence is there for a trial so the charges are to be dropped. The FT CAN RETRY but the judicial authority must carefully reexamine the new evidence.
5. Declare Incompetent- Basically the defendant is insane. Once this is granted a medical official is to examine the patient. If he is indeed insane he is to be placed under care of the medical staff until he is deemed competent to stand trial.

ALL SIDES MOVE TO A COURTROOM
Pre-Trial Hearings:
A judicial authority and the 2 sides are to meet in the trial room. NO ONE ELSE BESIDES A SECURITY DETAIL IS TO BE PRESENT. The defense submits a plea. If the plea is guilty then proceed directly to sentencing phase. Now the sides each present their motions to the judicial authority. He rules on them. Each side can debate each motion. Then the judicial authority gets a list of crew members. He first gets a chance to look at them all and pick out acceptable and available jurors. Those jurors are then called over. Each side can ask a few questions and dismiss jurors they find too biased. HOWEVER before dismissal the judicial authority MUST agree to the reasoning.

The Trial:
The trial has three phases.
1. Opening Arguments- Each side can give a short speech. They may not present ANY evidence.
2. Witness Calling/Evidence Presentation- The prosecution goes first and is able to call the witnesses on his approved list in any order. He can recall them if necessary. During the questioning the lawyer may use the evidence in the questions to help prove a point. After every witness the other side has a chance to cross-examine. After both sides are done questioning a witness the prosecution can present another or recall one (even the EXACT same one again!). After prosecution is done the defense can call witnesses. After the initial cases are presented both sides are free to call witnesses on either list.
FINALLY once both sides are done calling witnesses we move onto the next phase.
3. Closing Arguments- Same as opening.
The jury then deliberates IN PRIVATE. THEY MUST ALL AGREE on a verdict. REMEMBER: They mix between some charges being guilty and others not guilty (IE if you supposedly killed someone with a gun and you unfortunately picked up a gun without authorization then you CAN be found not guilty of murder BUT guilty of possession of illegal weaponry.). Once they have agreed they present their verdict. If unable to reach a verdict and feel they will never they call a deadlocked jury and we restart at Pre-Trial phase with an entirely new set of jurors.

Sentencing Phase:
If the death penalty was sought (you MUST have gone through a trial for death penalty) then skip to the second part.
I. Each side can present more evidence/witnesses in any order. There is NO ban on emotional aspects or anything. The prosecution is to submit a suggested penalty. After all the sides are done then the judicial authority is to give a sentence.
II. The jury stays and does the same thing as I. Their sole job is to determine if the death penalty is applicable. If NOT then the judge selects a sentence.

TADA you're done. Security then executes the sentence and adds the applicable convictions to the person's record.

Dissection for Dummies

1. Acquire fresh specimen.
2. Put the specimen on the operating table.
3. Apply surgical drapes, preparing for experimental dissection.
4. Apply scalpel to the specimen's torso.
5. Clamp bleeders on the specimen's torso with a hemostat.
6. Retract the skin of the specimen's torso with a retractor.
7. Apply scalpel again to the specimen's torso.
8. Search through the specimen's torso with your hands to remove any superfluous organs.
9. Insert replacement gland (retrieve one from gland storage).
10. Consider dressing the specimen back so as not to disturb their habitat.
11. Put the specimen in the experiment machinery.
12. Choose one of the machine options. The target will be analyzed and teleported to the selected drop-off point.
13. You will receive one supply credit, and the subject will be counted towards your quota.

Welcome to the Nanotrasen Gateway project...
Congratulations! If you're reading this, you and your superiors have decided that you're ready to commit to a life spent colonising the rolling hills of far away worlds. You must be ready for a lifetime of adventure, a little bit of hard work, and an award winning dental plan - but that's not all the Nanotrasen Gateway project has to offer.

Because we care about you, we feel it is only fair to make sure you know the risks before you commit to joining the Nanotrasen Gateway project. All away destinations have been fully scanned by a Nanotrasen expeditionary team, and are certified to be 100% safe. We've even left a case of space beer along with the basic materials you'll need to expand Nanotrasen's operational area and start your new life.

Gateway Operation Basics
All Nanotrasen approved Gateways operate on the same basic principals. They operate off area equipment power as you would expect, and without this supply, it cannot safely function, causing it to reject all attempts at operation.

Once it is correctly setup, and once it has enough power to operate, the Gateway will begin searching for an output location. The amount of time this takes is variable, but the Gateway interface will give you an estimate accurate to the minute. Power loss will not interrupt the searching process. Influenza will not interrupt the searching process. Temporal anomalies may cause the estimate to be inaccurate, but will not interrupt the searching process.

Life On The Other Side
Once you have traversed the Gateway, you may experience some disorientation. Do not panic. This is a normal side effect of travelling vast distances in a short period of time. You should survey the immediate area, and attempt to locate your complimentary case of space beer. Our expeditionary teams have ensured the complete safety of all away locations, but in a small number of cases, the Gateway they have established may not be immediately obvious. Do not panic if you cannot locate the return Gateway. Begin colonisation of the destination.

A New World
As a participant in the Nanotrasen Gateway Project, you will be on the frontiers of space. Though complete safety is assured, participants are advised to prepare for inhospitable environs.

NANOTRASEN - CREW RECOVERY DEPARTMENT
Body Intake Card
The bag contains the remains of a crew member recovered from a wreck. The body has been preserved with formaldehyde, so it undergoes no further decomposition.

Procedure:
1. Take the bag to medbay and lay the body on an operating table.
2. Examine it with a health analyzer: check organs, missing limbs, blood level and wounds.
3. Repair or replace damaged organs (heart, lungs, liver), sew on a missing limb or fit a prosthetic, replenish blood.
4. Remove the formaldehyde from the blood (activated charcoal or blood filtration), because after revival it poisons the patient.
5. Heal injuries enough for the patient to survive and use a defibrillator.

After a successful resuscitation the body will be taken over by a volunteer: the patient doesn't remember who they were, they only know their name and job. If nobody volunteers, the body will die again.

Bonus: if the patient survives three minutes after resuscitation, the medical department will receive 3000 credits.

<h1>Jedzenie dla opornych</h1>\\n\t\t\t\:
Food for Dummies

Here is a guide to basic recipes and to how not to accidentally poison your customers.

Preparing basic ingredients:

Dough: 10u water + 15u flour makes normal dough.
15u egg yolk + 15u flour + 5u sugar makes cake batter.
Dough can be processed with a knife and a rolling pin.
Any dough can be baked in a microwave.
Bowl: add water to it to prepare soup.
Meat: bake it in a microwave, process it, slice it with a knife into cutlets for the microwave, or use it raw.
Cheese: add 5u of universal enzyme (catalyst) to milk and soy milk to make cheese (for slicing) and tofu.
Rice: mix 10u of rice with 10u of water in a bowl, then heat it in a microwave.

Custom dishes:

Add ingredients to a base to make your own dish.
The bases are:
- bun (burger)
- bread slices (sandwich)
- plain bread
- plain pie
- vanilla cake
- empty bowl (salad)
- bowl with 10u of water (soup)
- cooked spaghetti
- pizza base
- iron rod (kebab)

Crafting on a table:

Place ingredients on a table, then click and drag the table onto yourself to see what you can make.

Microwave:

Used for cooking and baking ingredients (meat, dough, eggs, spaghetti, dumplings, etc.). It can prepare several things at once.

Processor:

Used for processing certain ingredients (meat into meatballs, a portion of dough into spaghetti, potatoes into fries, etc.)

Grinder:

Shove an animal into it to grind it into meat.

Meat hook:

Impale an animal on it and start collecting meat.

Example recipes:

Vanilla cake: bake cake batter in a microwave.
Burger: 1 bun + 1 steak
Bread: bake dough in a microwave.
Waffles: 2 pastry bases
Popcorn: heat corn in a microwave.
Steak: bake meat in a microwave.
Meat pie: 1 plain pie + 1u black pepper + 1u salt + 2 cutlets
Cooked spaghetti: heat spaghetti in a microwave.
Donuts: 1u sugar + 1 pastry base
Fries: process a potato.

Sharing food:

You can put dishes on the kitchen counter or load them into snack vending machines.

<h4><center>Dziennik badań</center></h4>:
Research Log

I think I'm onto something!
The strange, space-bending properties of bluespace have been known for a long time, but I may be a step away from discovering a new way to use them.
It's too early to say for sure, but this could be the beginning of something really important!
I will definitely write down every major breakthrough. This might be too much for me to handle alone, maybe I should hire that secretary after all...

Breakthrough!

I can't believe it, but I did it! Just when I was sure it was impossible, I made the last breakthrough I needed.
Using the space-dilation effects produced by certain bluespace structures, combined with precise geometric calculations, I discovered a way to link an infinite amount of space to a finite area!
Though the possible applications are endless, for now I have used it in a rather neat way, designing a system that recursively creates subspace rooms and spatially links them to any of the infinitely many infinitesimally small, distinct points on the surface of a sphere.
I call it: Hilbert's Hotel!

Farewell

I can't take it anymore. I know what comes next, and the fear of what's coming won't let me keep working.
Every fool in my field has heard the stories. Not that I didn't believe them, I just... I guess I underestimated the weight of my own research...
Robert reports that strange, nosy visitors who ask questions they have no right to ask are coming more and more often. I asked him to keep everything under strict lockdown, and I permanently dismissed all the other assistants.
I also told him to use the encryption method we discussed for all the important numerical data. Poor boy... I think he doesn't quite understand what he's gotten himself into...
It's clear what will happen now. One day they will show up uninvited and appropriate my research, and all that will be left of me is a bullet-riddled corpse drifting in space.
I can't stay and let that happen.
I'm escaping into the very thing that brought all this trouble on me - my hotel.
I'll be in [uppertext(num2hex(GLOB.hhmysteryRoomNumber, 0))] (anyone who should understand will)
I'm sorry I have to leave this way. Maybe one day everything will change and it will be safe to come back... maybe...
Farewell

Doctor Hilbert
<h4>Dzień 1</h4>\\n\tJesteśmy bardzo pod:
Day 1

We are very excited to be part of the first crew of the SC Irmanda!
This ship was built to test innovative FTL technology. I had some concerns at first, but the engineers assure me it is safe and that there is absolutely no risk of the outer wings falling off during acceleration.
We are to test the latest model of the Thinktronic cloning pod. We will spend a week docked before launch, but we're starting right away. If the engine is as fast as they say, we might not have time to run all the routine tests on the cloned subject!

Day 2

We cloned an unidentified corpse handed over to us by the medical staff. The genetic replication is good enough that the subject survives outside the pod, but the cellular damage still raises concerns about its long-term survival. We are keeping it in quarantine to be safe.
We left it some books, but apparently we were too optimistic about its mental capacity. Its brain seems to suffer from the same clonal degradation that previous models caused. We will run further tests to see if there is any improvement.

Day 4

Looks like we will launch even earlier than we expected! Apparently the press is starting to lose interest, so we have to shorten the pre-launch checks and give them something to talk about. Hopefully this ends in more funding...
The whole crew has been invited to the main hall, where we have seats for the initial FTL acceleration. Unfortunately the clone cannot leave isolation without risking infection, so we will strap it to the bed and hope for the best. Besides, if anything goes wrong, we can always grow another clone.
Professor Galen Linkovich

<h4>Pierwszy tydzień!</h4>\\n\tPierwszy:
First Week!

My first week at the new job. It's a secretary position, but whatever, as long as it pays the bills. Besides, it looks like interesting things are going on here.
The Doctor says it's best if I don't talk openly with others about his research; I guess he doesn't want anything to leak. A few times I caught myself letting something slip in conversation, it's hard not to brag about something so cool!
I'm not sure why I decided to write this down. The Doctor seems to write everything down. He says it's in case he discovers something important.
Probably why I'm doing it too, I always wanted to be part of something important.
Here's to the new job and to becoming part of something important!

Strange Times...

Things are getting a bit weird here. Only a few weeks after the Doctor's amazing breakthrough, strange visitors started showing up unannounced, asking odd questions about his work.
I knew the Doctor wasn't fond of company, but even he seemed strangely nervous when I told him about the visitors.
He said that from now on we have to keep everything strictly secured, even from the other employees.
He also said something about securing the data, something about hexes. What does that mean? Some kind of curse? The Doctor never struck me as the magic type...
He often uses a lot of big scientific words that I don't really understand, but I kind of like it, it feels like I'm witnessing something great.
I hope everything goes back to normal soon, but I guess that's the price of being part of something important.

Last Day, I Think?

It's officially getting too weird for me.
The visitors come more and more often and they all seem more and more aggressive and nosy. I'm starting to understand why they made the Doctor so nervous, they're starting to scare me too.
Some time ago the Doctor told me to keep this place under strict lockdown and refuse entry to everyone else, including former employees.
But here's the weirdest part.
I haven't seen the Doctor for several days. It's not unusual for him to work in the lab for days on end, but when I looked in there yesterday - he was nowhere to be found! I didn't risk snooping any further, over the last few weeks the Doctor had a habit of leaving the defense systems on.
I think maybe it's time to quit. I can't do much without the boss, and besides, it's getting suspicious. I wanted to be part of something important, but you have to know when to play it safe.
As my dad always used to say: “The wise earn fame, but the prudent survive...”

Robert P.

A common misunderstanding is Nar-Sie's title: why exactly is he the Blood Geometer? Nobody dared ask him directly, so as not to offend him, so for a long time many cultists simply assumed he was truly passionate about geometry, and the fact that his power manifests through bloody drawings with precise patterns seemed to confirm it.

Eventually a few cultists decided to make contact with him and learn the answer, making a few sacrifices beforehand just to be sure. The answer was surprising and shed new light on the beginnings of the cult. They learned that when the wizards broke through to his plane, it took some time before they found him, just as people are not aware of every ant in their garden. But when they did come across him, his enormous form stretched against the landscape resembled a geometer moth.

And just as moths are drawn to light, Nar-Sie was drawn to blood, so they called him the Blood Geometer, and he took a great liking to that title.

The deeper humanity ventures into the darkness of space and toys with powers it understands less and less, the more clearly Nar-Sie feels he is getting closer, and he now wants to speed that process up. His cult sends out heralds to let humanity know how much he likes it (mainly its blood), and until he is ready to invite it into his realm, they leave blood-spattered space stations among the stars as his calling card.

People who had until then stood firmly on the ground became fascinated by something mystical, yet tangible.

And of course there also came those who wanted to oppose him, in the name of their own gods or their own sense of morality. Few of them know that Nar-Sie loves them just as much and cares little whose blood is flowing.

Using the tablet

  1. Open the Syndicate Contract Uplink program.
  2. Here you can accept a contract and collect TC payouts for completed contracts.
  3. The amount in parentheses is the bonus you receive for delivering the target alive. You receive the other amount regardless of whether the target is alive.
  4. You complete a contract by delivering the target to the designated drop-off point, calling extraction and placing them in the pod.

Be careful when accepting a contract. You will see the location of the drop-off point, but cancelling will make it impossible to accept it again.

The tablet can also be charged in any cell charger.

Extraction

  1. Make sure you and your target are at the drop-off point.
  2. Call extraction and step away from the drop-off point.
  3. If it fails, make sure the target is inside and that there is a free spot for the pod to land.
  4. Grab the target and pull them into the pod.

Ransoms

We need your target for our own purposes, but once they are no longer useful we send them back, for a ransom, to the area of your mission. They will return after a few minutes at the place you sent them from. Don't worry, you will get a cut of what they pay us. We will deposit it on the ID card you are carrying, in addition to your TC payout.

Good luck, agent. You may burn this document with the included lighter.

It has a mount for a tank's relief valve, set on a curved pipe specially built to withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and a mechanical trigger that operates the valve. In practice it turns the force of a bomb's explosion into a narrow shockwave - a “projectile”. Ambitious scientists may find it extremely useful, because focusing the pressure wave into a narrow angle apparently bypasses the quirk of physics that keeps explosions from exceeding a certain range. Refraction Matrix - PN #JDP44456S01 

The matrix interface calibrates reagent cloud probabilities on a base coordinate grid.
Within each reagent cloud, one grid point corresponds to a stable refraction index.

Insert a disk and compile grid coordinates onto it. To check refraction stability, you have to
inject the gene into a plant. Unstable refractions can damage the plant's DNA.

A stable refraction will make the plant start producing the given reagent.

You can also take a reagent sample from a container to discover a stable refraction right away. This will also
reveal nearby stable refractions.

This feature is a work in progress

Wirus leczy ciało nosiciela, gdy ten prz: The virus heals the host's body while they are in darkness. Works best on physical damage.
Wirus lekko utrudnia oddychanie, przez c: The virus slightly impedes breathing, causing the host to wheeze.
Wirus nadprodukuje czynniki krzepnięcia:: The virus overproduces clotting factors: it stops bleeding and quickly restores lost blood.
Wirus nadprodukuje komórki macierzyste u: The virus overproduces stem cells geared toward forming organs. The finished organs are pushed out of the body, and the host is injured in the process.
Wirus osłabia budowę ciała. Każda część: The virus weakens the body's structure. Every body part withstands less and less damage.
Wirus osłabia skórę nosiciela. Pęka ona: The virus weakens the host's skin. It tears at every collision and touch.
Wirus pobiera plazmę z otoczenia, z butl: The virus draws plasma from the environment, from canisters and from the host's blood to heal damage and equalize body temperature.
Wirus pobudza organizm do wytwarzania an: The virus stimulates the body to produce antitoxin, which cleanses the blood and liver.
Wirus pobudza ośrodek przyjemności. Nosi: The virus stimulates the pleasure center. The host feels wonderful.
Wirus pobudza wzrost komórek i leczy obr: The virus stimulates cell growth and heals physical damage and burns, but the repair leaves toxins in the body.
Wirus pobudza ślinianki. Nosiciel się śl: The virus stimulates the salivary glands. The host drools.
Wirus podrażnia kanaliki łzowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the tear ducts. The host's eyes water.
Wirus podrażnia nerwy ruchowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the motor nerves. The host twitches involuntarily.
Wirus poświęca długoterminową przeżywaln: The virus sacrifices long-term survivability to spread fully through the host almost instantly. It starts at the last stage, but eventually fades away and dies off on its own.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w jas: The virus remodels the host's body into a lizard. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w ćmę: The virus remodels the host's body into a moth. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus rozkręca w ciele nosiciela nieustę: The virus winds up a relentless rhythm in the host's body. At first only strange feelings and shortness of breath, then fever and fire, and in the end the body can't take the rhythm and explodes.
Wirus rozregulowuje ośrodek strachu. Nos: The virus dysregulates the fear center. The host has panic attacks, and in the last stage coughs up butterflies.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele nosiciela „cie: The virus synthesizes a \"thin mint\" in the host's body: a substance that messes with the head.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele olej i inne ma: The virus synthesizes oil and other inorganic materials in the body, which the host expels. Rarely a whole robot jumps out of the mouth.
Wirus szybko przystosowuje się do jak na: The virus quickly adapts to spread as fast as possible, both outside and inside the host. As a result, however, it is easier to detect and defends itself worse against a cure. This symptom encourages mutation of the disease
Wirus uszkadza naczynia w nosie. Nosicie: The virus damages the vessels in the nose. The host gets nosebleeds, and the blood may carry the virus.
Wirus wyczula nosiciela na bóle i zakwas: The virus sensitizes the host to aches and soreness, making them tire faster.
Wirus wykorzystuje wodę w ciele i na nim: The virus uses water in and on the body to repair damaged cells. Heals burns best, and holy water works stronger.
Wirus wywołuje zapalenie błędnika. Nosic: The virus causes labyrinthitis. The host feels dizzy.
Wirus zagnieżdża się w ośrodkach społecz: The virus nests in the brain's social centers: it rewards the host for being in a crowd of potential victims and punishes them for being alone.
Wirus łączy się symbiotycznie z komórkam: The virus bonds symbiotically with the cells of the host's body, preventing aging and reversing it. In return, the virus becomes more resistant, spreads faster and is harder to detect, although it develops worse without a host.

Under-tile panel: lay a tile over it → expected: it disappears under the tile and still works. Implant: implant with an implanter. 8) Our components: bitwise (option And: 6 and 3 → 2), round (option Round: 2.6 → 3, Floor: 2, Ceil: 3), bitflag, advanced trigonometry (e.g. sinh 0 → 0) → expected: correct results on the outputs. 9) Camera/PDA/MOD module as shells: insert a circuit and trigger the camera component → expected: the camera takes a photo, the PDA and the MOD module accept the circuit as a shell (the circuit window opens). Zestaw: Wyznacznik Stref Promu, RCD, ste: Kit: Rapid Shuttle Designator, RCD, shuttle flight controller, void engine, plasma engine with heater, plasma canister, cryogenic fuel tank and the captain's spare ID. 1) Sabre on the map: the hangar (on Atlas the mining bay in the south, nose east towards the doors, and the widened hangar next to Trafalgar, nose north) holds the Sabre interior, without a sprite. The hull on an east-facing port has its picture turned as a whole, with no shuffled pieces. The „Sabre hangar doors” button by the doors opens and closes them. Empty hand on the left nacelle (hatch) → you get inside; without pilot/miner access → „Access denied” (negative). The doors in the cockpit → you step out onto the tile in front of the hatch. 2) Service: the hose from the cryogenic fuel tank by the hatch, clicked on the hatch → refuels the Sabre (examining the hatch shows the fuel); an ID on the hatch → the maintenance/eject mode window; dragging a crate onto the hatch → cargo hold. 3) Launch: the helm in the cockpit → the „Take off?” question, Launch → the interior disappears from the hangar, the Sabre is on the overmap next to the ship and the helm flies it like a dropship. With an empty tank the launch is refused (negative). In flight the doors are locked. 4) Landing: turn on docking mode and fly into the ship → a message about looking for a spot, the interior returns to its port in the hangar. At a target without a port (abandoned station, asteroid) → the interior sets down in space next to the target's hull so that the doors open onto the target's floor (if there is a free spot by the floor). 5) Shuttle from the Designator: build a small room with the RCD with a floor, an outer wall and an airlock, put the flight controller and an engine inside (the void engine works without fuel; the plasma engine needs a heater facing the same way and plasma from the canister), designate the shuttle with the Designator and use it on the airlock. Controller → „Take off?” → the shuttle flies around the overmap with its own sprite, coming back in docking mode to the building site. Without engines or without fuel the launch is refused with a message (negative).

S.A.Y.A.: use in hand → a defensive stance. A.R.A.S.A.K.A. (briefcase): dashes to a target 3 tiles away. 5) Strong-Arm: in combat mode hit the second human → expected: the target is thrown back; a pair of Strong-Arms pries doors with an empty hand. (the mask and tank grow), C.C.M.S. lets you hold two weapons in combat mode. S.M.A.R.T.: take a pistol or laser in the hand with the implant → expected: a shot counter of the weapon above the hand. (renew), headlights give a cone of light, exiting throws you outside. 2) Assemble the second one from parts: an EVA helmet on the ground, then a robot leg, a second leg, a flashlight, a screwdriver, a voice module, a screwdriver, a tank → expected: after the last step a VIM is made. On the server (not in CI) the kit asks whether to add the Abandoned station mission with a chosen objective, and then whether to open the next mission choice. 1) Abandoned station: after adding the mission the admin log shows „station interior ready on Z level …”, and the briefing (communications console, Mission status) shows the objective text, system and reward. A grey abandoned station appears on the overmap in that system. A dropship or a fighter with an FTL drive and a docking computer in docking mode flies into the station → expected: it appears in space next to a ruin with rooms and corridors in one of the themes (abandoned, blob, xenomorphs, netherworld, Ratvar). A regular fighter without FTL doesn't dock (negative, same as station boarding). 2) Objectives (chosen when adding): black box (GPS „CZARNA SKRZYNKA”) used in hand on the ship's bridge → balloon, announcement with the amount and the mission COMPLETED; artifact brought to the ship → completed; nuclear decommissioning → Central Command report with the code, the bomb drops in a pod on the station, the disk lies elsewhere, after arming and the explosion everyone on the station level dies, mission completed, and an armed bomb taken off the station level disarms (negative); VIP brought to the ship alive and conscious → completed, dead VIP without a player → FAILED; assassination → completed after the target dies. Zestaw: plecak odrzutowy, hardsuit inżyn: Kit: jetpack, engineering hardsuit, radiation suit and hood, Geiger counter, plutonium rod, potassium iodide bottle, health analyzer, syringe, toxin bottle, burger, cola, ID console, NtOS command console (ID card program), CentCom console, captain's spare ID, CentCom ID and a blank ID. 1) Jetpack: put on the jetpack, turn it on and go out into space. Flying uses fuel (gas analyzer on the tank: it drops with every step in vacuum), in gravity it uses none. With stabilizers the character stops after releasing the key, without them they keep drifting. Empty tank → the jetpack turns off (negative). A jetpack held in hand has no toggle button (negative). Release a pulled object while flying → it keeps flying. The space background scrolls smoothly; FTL jump and the pilot's overmap view unchanged. 2) Access: insert the captain's ID and the blank ID into the ID console → 8 station groups in Polish, toggling a single access works. Give the blank ID the MAA assignment, log out and log in with the MAA ID → it only sees Uzbrojenie and cannot grant Captain access (negative). Demote a Majtek → works. On the command console open the ID card program and log in with the captain's ID → the groups show up immediately (without reopening the window), „Nadaj region” grants the clicked department. On the CentCom console with the CentCom ID: Centrala and Inne groups. 3) Stomach: eat the burger and drink the cola, scan with the analyzer → reagents in the „Zawartość żołądka” section, in the blood after about 40 s. Inject 10 u of toxin with the syringe → in the blood immediately, the liver takes damage; 2 u of toxin in food → no effect. Vomit → it drains from the stomach, not from the blood. 4) Radiation: stand next to the plutonium rod without protection → the Geiger counter clicks and shows the level, a scan shows the irradiation percentage; from 20% glow and an alert. In the full radiation suit → no increase; in the engineering hardsuit with helmet too. The suit alone without the helmet does not protect (negative). Walk away → the percentage drops on its own by about 0.1%/s, faster with potassium iodide. A wall between you and the rod weakens the pulse.

A spare captain's card (access to the lockers), an emag and a screwdriver also lie around. 1) Open the lockers in turn with the card: sec, warden, HoS, the armory, tac (lethalshots), bio, and also the shotgun case → expected: all have navy-and-white icons (closed, open, locked), there is no red anywhere. 2) HoS and Warden lockers: look through the contents → expected: no HoS leather jacket, red supergarsy, white and female parade uniform, or the corporate beret in the Warden's locker (negative: these things do not appear in any locker). 3) SecDrobe (click, the clothing tab) → expected: a POLICE sign and a blue light; the offer includes police uniforms, hats from the sheet (alt, police bandana, garrison cap), and does NOT include a red bandana, a red armband, a red tie, khaki, blueshirt, mallcop, a corporate uniform and beret, and emagging does not reveal the old winter coat (negative: contraband empty). 4) Security airlock: touch it with a screwdriver (open the panel) and an emag → expected: the door is navy, the yellow warning stripes stay, the open panel and the opening animation have no red elements. 5) Put on the Aspirant uniform with an armband (pin the armband to the uniform) → expected: the uniform looks like a police uniform, not a mallcop one, the armband is navy (on the character and in the inventory). 6) Put on each hat (alt, Warden's, bandana, garrison cap, officer's) and the prison doctor's hat, apron, vest and uniform → expected: all are visible on the character (before they vanished), the doctor has navy instead of red. 7) Security/HoS tablets: navy icons and colors. HoS bedsheet on the neck → expected: the worn sprite is visible. 8) Lay the police carpet tiles next to each other → expected: they join into one pattern; the decals on the floor (four fields next to each other) are navy, without red tiles.

SAY Before continuing, make sure the room is sealed. Apart from the flag officer of engineering, no other officer should be present.
DELAY 20
SAY You have 15 seconds to comply.
DELAY 150
SAY Project Zelbinion is a defensive screen reactor. It works by projecting hardened particles around the ship.
DELAY 50
SAY The reactor is fueled by Nucleum, a byproduct of plasma-enriched nuclear fission.
DELAY 50
SAY Once started, the reactor must run continuously until shutdown. The particle stream cannot be interrupted, or it risks an emission.
DELAY 50
SAY Project Zelbinion has automatic shutdown procedures that should prevent a causality failure, however your ship will NOT come out of this unscathed.
DELAY 50
SAY The reactor is operated from two consoles. Use them together to control the reaction.
DELAY 50
SAY The first parameter you control is the input power. Do not exceed the stated maximum power and do not go below the minimum. This risks an emission.
DELAY 50
SAY By increasing the input power, you also increase the PDSR's ability to project particles around the ship, which yields a stronger particle screen.
DELAY 50
SAY Another reaction variable you control is the Nucleum injection rate. A higher rate, like power, yields a stronger shield.
DELAY 50
SAY The Nucleum injection can be sharply increased for a quick boost in combat, but beware: it will destabilize the reactor.
DELAY 50
SAY The shield variables themselves can be controlled separately. Use this to your advantage.
DELAY 50
SAY Reactor stability is affected by the polarity of the reaction. If needed, switch the injection polarity from negative to positive to keep the polarity as close to 0 as possible.
DELAY 50
SAY If you must shut down the reactor, slowly reduce the Nucleum injection rate. In an emergency you can flush the coolant to quickly cool the reactor.
DELAY 50
SAY The reaction can be terminated when the reactor core is below 200 degrees Celsius. Ensure adequate cooling to achieve this.
DELAY 50
SAY Finally: if the minimum input power starts approaching the maximum, you are heading for an emission. Fix it immediately or shut down the reactor safely.
DELAY 50
SAY In the event of losing the Iowa, the Chief Engineer is authorized to destroy the PDSR using the provided evidence disposal terminal.
DELAY 50
SAY Do your duty. This tape should be destroyed after use. Shield technology does not exist. Glory to Nanotrasen.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 1
SAY WELCOME TO THE NSV GALACTICA.
NAME David 'Record Keeper' Bregg
SAY Welcome to the VICKER media educational chronicles! In this series you will learn all about key historical events, just as they happened.
DELAY 20
SAY Edit me!
DELAY 30
SAY Our journey begins 30 years ago, when this ship was built. She was designed as a battleship meant to lead the SolGov fleet in response to Nanotrasen's aggressive military expansion in the 2210s, and boasted impressive firepower.
DELAY 30
SAY Estimates put this ship's firepower on par with three Nanotrasen Aegis-class light cruisers, but she has since been decommissioned and, due to her historical significance, turned into a museum!
DELAY 30
SAY In the next installment you'll learn about Solaria's role in several key conflicts. And for now, goodbye! And enjoy touring the museum...
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 1
SAY WELCOME TO THE NSV GALACTICA.
NAME Senior Fleetyard Engineer Beck
SAY The NSV Galactica, originally developed under the name “Iowa”, is Nanotrasen's current flagship. Weighing 500,000 tons, she is the largest ship in active service!
DELAY 20
SAY The third in a line of great ships bearing the name Galactica, this version is by far the most destructive of her lineage.
DELAY 30
SAY Descended from the SGV Solaria, the former SolGov flagship, the original Galactica sailed briefly a few years ago, and her voyage ended in the Battle of Tartar, in which the heroic engineer Patel blew up a planet in the name of the corporation.
DELAY 30
SAY Patel sacrificed himself to destroy a Syndicate sleeper agent programming facility, but soon afterwards the original Galactica's voyage came to an end when the blast wave caught up with her.
DELAY 30
SAY After Galactica's destruction, CaracalCorp salvagers immediately began recovery work. Entire departments were torn apart, but remained relatively intact...
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 1
SAY WELCOME TO THE SOLARIA.
NAME Joe 'Schlomo' Speedwagon
SAY Welcome to the SGV Solaria! I'm Joe and I'll be your guide.
DELAY 30
SAY This is the first of several informational holotapes recorded by VICKER media on commission from the Solarian Government.
DELAY 30
SAY Our journey begins 30 years ago, when this ship was built. She was designed as a battleship meant to lead the SolGov fleet in response to Nanotrasen's aggressive military expansion in the 2210s, and boasted impressive firepower.
DELAY 30
SAY Estimates put this ship's firepower on par with three Nanotrasen Aegis-class light cruisers, but she has since been decommissioned and, due to her historical significance, turned into a museum!
DELAY 30
SAY In the next installment you'll learn about Solaria's role in several key conflicts. And for now, goodbye! And enjoy touring the museum...
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 2
SAY WELCOME TO THE NSV GALACTICA.
NAME Senior Fleetyard Engineer Beck
SAY When salvage operations ended due to Syndicate interference, the remaining parts of the former Solaria were sent back to the shipyard.
DELAY 20
SAY TitanWerks engineers have been studying the wreckage for several years and made an important discovery... Before SolGov handed Solaria over to us to become Galactica, they stripped her of all of her signature technologies.
DELAY 30
SAY It turned out that the ship still had all the focal points needed to generate shields intact, even though the entire shield projection apparatus had been removed.
DELAY 30
SAY While I can't physically record too much detail about the ship's technical data, I can tell you this much: Galactica is one of a kind.
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 2
SAY WELCOME TO THE NSV GALACTICA.
NAME Senior Fleetyard Engineer Beck
SAY The NSV Galactica is a warship. You're not likely to find luxuries here; she was built for one purpose and excels at it.
DELAY 20
SAY The NSV Galactica has 4 main batteries with 8 NT-BSG Gauss guns, 6 NT-HOOD naval artillery cannons and experimental bluespace artillery.
DELAY 30
SAY Alongside the impressive physical artillery, the bluespace artillery beam is a new breakthrough in bluespace technology that does not violate any SolGov sanctions whatsoever!
DELAY 30
SAY Galactica was built in direct response to Syndicate aggression and is equipped to level colonies and entire fleets alike.
DELAY 30
SAY That concludes our technical data miniseries, enjoy touring the rest of the museum!
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 2
SAY WELCOME TO THE SOLARIA.
NAME Joe 'Schlomo' Speedwagon
SAY Welcome to the SGV Solaria! I'm Joe and I'll be your guide.
DELAY 30
SAY This is the second of several informational holotapes recorded by VICKER media on commission from the Solarian Government.
DELAY 30
SAY Solaria took part in many border skirmishes, but since she was created mainly as a ship of peace, she rarely saw heavy fighting.
DELAY 30
SAY Her most famous feat was dealing a crushing blow to the Jovian felinid abductor networks, when she single-handedly faced an entire fleet of transports!
DELAY 30
SAY Unfortunately, that's all for today. Watch the next installment to learn Solaria's technical specifications. And for now, goodbye! And enjoy touring the museum...
DELAY 30
SAY END OF RECORDING. INSERT NEXT DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE NO. 3
SAY WELCOME TO THE SOLARIA.
NAME Joe 'Schlomo' Speedwagon
SAY Welcome to the SGV Solaria! I'm Joe and I'll be your guide.
DELAY 30
SAY This is the last of several informational holotapes recorded by VICKER media on commission from the Solarian Government.
DELAY 30
SAY In the last installment I told you about Solaria's rich history, and now it's time for the technical side!
DELAY 30
SAY Solaria boasts 8 Gauss guns, 4 electromagnetic railguns and even more torpedo launchers!
DELAY 30
SAY She is built to withstand a thermonuclear blast of up to 200 Mt, though this has never been tested!
DELAY 30
SAY Solaria is capable of long faster-than-light voyages, and at her peak she had an experimental class 2 stormdrive, capable of delivering megawatts of power! Unfortunately, after decommissioning, Solaria's stormdrive was replaced with a more stable fission reactor.
DELAY 30
SAY Thank you for joining me on this journey, and I hope your pursuit of knowledge doesn't end here! The museum has plenty of reading material, and you can also see some of the ship's departments, preserved exactly as they were used 30 years ago!
DELAY 30
SAY This is Joe Speedwagon, over and out.
SAY END OF SERIES.

text: 'Dobrze znosisz chłód i niskie ciś: text: 'You tolerate cold and low pressure well, but extreme cold and vacuum hurt you. This does not affect you inside a host, and a spacesuit will protect the host.',
text: 'Dorosły robak może się rozmnożyć:: text: 'An adult worm can reproduce: 3 new larvae come out of the cocoon, and you yourself return to larva form.',
text: 'Gdy zostanie ci mniej niż 10% zdr: text: 'If less than 10% of your health remains in the blood, the host will eject you. It is a chance to escape at the last moment.',
text: 'Każda udzielona lekcja dodaje nam: text: 'Every lesson given adds to our strength. With right click we can turn walls into glass to reach even further.',
text: 'Korporacja DeForest stworzyła jed: text: 'The DeForest Corporation has created single-use testers that detect blood worms. Security can order them from cargo. They work instantly, but they hurt and are expensive.',
text: 'Larwy chodzą rurami wentylacji. P: text: 'Larvae travel through ventilation pipes. After maturing you lose this ability and are left with slipping under doors, breaking doors down and ID access. Before you mature, find a good spot or a host.',
text: 'Leczenie nosiciela w medbayu zami: text: 'Healing a host in medbay instead of with your own blood does not leave them deathly pale and saves blood for spitting and healing.',
text: 'Lodówki z krwią w medbayu to niez: text: 'Blood fridges in medbay are a decent source of synthetic blood when there are no monkeys. Be careful, breaking a fridge can be heard through walls.',
text: 'Mały zasięg ataku i znikome obraż: text: 'Short attack range and negligible damage, but great for quick escapes and repositioning.',
text: 'Możesz wyjść z nosiciela, by kogo: text: 'You can leave a host to surprise someone, especially as an adult. Cut off escape routes first, because exiting takes 3 seconds.',
text: 'Nie musisz oddychać. Dotyczy to t: text: 'You do not need to breathe. This applies to your hosts as well.',
text: 'Nosiciel nie potrzebuje oddychać: text: 'A host does not need to breathe or have a working heart and liver, a brain is enough. You can revive a dead host with its own blood.',
text: 'Nosicielom brakuje twoich zmysłów: text: 'Hosts lack your senses, so darkness and flashbangs affect them normally. Night vision goggles, eye protection and ear protection will help.',
text: 'Ochrona cię złapała? Z aktywnym P: text: 'Caught by security? With Blood Spit active, right click dissolves handcuffs, straitjackets and even locker hinges. You can also leave the host and escape through the vents or through the door.',
text: 'Postęp wzrostu widać na przycisku: text: 'Growth progress is visible on the maturation button and when hovering over the worm icon in the top right corner. Once you have grown, seal yourself in a cocoon to advance to the next stage. A young worm spits blood, and an adult is extremely strong.',
text: 'Potrafisz zamienić się w krew i w: text: 'You can turn into blood and enter a human corpse, making it your host. You can also drag yourself onto a corpse.',
text: 'Powoli się leczysz, z progu śmier: text: 'You heal slowly, from the brink of death to full health in about 5 minutes. In a host this means slowly regaining blood. By injecting blood you quickly heal the host at the cost of your own health.',
text: 'Rośniesz, pijąc krew Wysysaniem k: text: 'You grow by drinking blood with Blood Drain or by entering corpses. Synthetic blood, e.g. from monkeys and blood bags, counts towards growth only up to a certain limit. The HUD shows the blood level of everyone, and examining a target tells you how much blood they have and how much they would give you.',
text: 'Twój umysł nie jest ludzki. Nie z: text: 'Your mind is not human. You know no fear, even in a host.',
text: 'W kosmosie jesteś niewidzialny i: text: 'In space you are invisible and your wounds heal. You pass freely through glass, but an electrified grille will stop you.',
text: 'W nosicielu cały jesteś krwią, wi: text: 'Inside a host you are entirely blood, so their bleeding hurts you directly. Hosts also bleed after death and 50% faster than normal humans.',
text: 'Wnikając w zwłoki, błyskawicznie: text: 'By entering a corpse, you instantly drink all of its blood. Blood obtained while already in a host does not count towards growth.',
text: 'Wpatruj się w ofiarę, która cię w: text: 'Stare at a victim who sees you to stun and weaken them. This is how you give away your presence.',
text: 'Wysysasz powietrze prosto z płuc: text: 'You suck the air straight out of their lungs and quickly take down even the strongest. If they resist, right click deals normal damage. Your hands are only good for carrying things.',
text: 'Źle znosisz wysoką temperaturę i: text: 'You tolerate high temperatures poorly and burn up quickly in them. This also applies inside a host, unless you dress them in a fireproof outfit.',

Nuclear Devices for Beginners:
Good day, and thank you for choosing the Syndicate for your nuclear knowledge needs.
Today's crash course covers the operation of a Nanotrasen-made fusion-class nuclear charge.
First and foremost, DO NOT TOUCH ANYTHING UNTIL THE BOMB IS IN PLACE.
Pressing any button on the assembled bomb will make it deploy and bolt itself to the floor.
To unbolt it again you must be fully logged in, which may not be possible at the moment.
To arm the nuclear charge:
  • Place the nuclear charge in the designated detonation zone.
  • Deploy and anchor the nuclear charge from its interface.
  • Insert the nuclear authentication disk into the slot.
  • Enter the numeric authorization code on the keypad. You should have been given it. Note: if you make a mistake, press R to reset the device.
  • Press the E button to log in to the device.
    • The device is now active. To deactivate the buttons at any time, for example when the bomb is already prepared for detonation, remove the authentication disk OR press R on the keypad.
    The bomb can now be detonated ONLY with a timer fuse. Manual detonation is out of the question.
    Note: Nanotrasen is a pain in the ass.
    Turn off the SAFETY.
    Note: you wouldn't believe how many Syndicate agents with doctorates forgot this step.
    Use - - and + + to set the detonation time from 5 seconds to 10 minutes.
    Then press the timer button to start the countdown.
    Now remove the authentication disk so the buttons deactivate.
    Note: THE BOMB IS STILL ARMED AND WILL EXPLODE
    If you need to move the bomb before removing the disk, you can:
    turn off the anchoring, move it and anchor it again.

    Good luck. Remember the order:
    Disk, code, safety, timer, disk, RUN!
    Intelligence analysts believe that, per standard Nanotrasen procedure, the nuclear authentication disk is secured by the captain.
    Good luck!
